title: Optimization closure and scene-conditioned fidelity of ER-v1-SDM (diagnostic follow-up of WL104K)
classification: Suffix batch of WL104K (owner-named WL104K-A): closes WL104K's evidence gaps; no new mechanism; WL104K's frozen verdict and its appended post hoc section are preserved unchanged.

inputs.wl104k: results/ecro_wl84_104k/primary/{fit_primary, fit_extended, eval, posthoc_scenes} authenticated against evaluation/104K/manifest.json raw_sha256 (fit / eval) and the hashes recorded at the start of this batch for posthoc_scenes (they were not in a frozen manifest; recorded in stageA.json before any new evidence).
inputs.references: WL104D Amendment 1 angular reference, WL104J fit / transfer sets, WL104G archived scene references and R0 launches (all authenticated through the WL104K / WL104J / WL104H chain).

stage_A.reproduce: Recompute held-out angular el1 of all 12k states (A / T / P x 4 starts) from the archived states and compare with evaluation/104K/eval.json tables (must agree to 1e-9 relative, else stop). Recompute the post hoc scene contrasts from the archived fixed-pass images (analysis.json) and record per-start objects stable RMS (E1, E2, TOTAL).
stage_A.uncertainty: Report separately: angular reference half-split noise; scene render-replicate uncertainty (12-replicate jackknife of each arm's stable RMS); across-start spread (4 starts) of angular el1 and of scene contrasts.
stage_A.ownership: Document from code and verify numerically: E1 = camera vertex on an ER object x next-event estimate of the single spot light (local wi = view side, wo = light side, weight rgb / d^2, visibility); E2 = one R0-proposal bounce from the ER vertex to another surface x that surface's native direct light, weight 1 / pdf (common proposal, F / p per arm); non-ER first vertices use the native BSDF (N part, identical in all arms); TOTAL = E1 + fixed E2 + archived R0 HIGH (events >= 3 of the archived R0 render, identical for all arms). Replay identity from WL104K post hoc analysis must hold (<= 2e-5 L1, lane F/p <= 2e-6).

stage_B.extension: From every 12k terminal state of A, T and P (4 starts), continue with the WL82 objective on the WL104J fit set for 12,000 further steps of Adam at constant lr 3e-4 (the WL82 schedule's terminal learning rate), float32, gates projected to [0, 1] after each step. The Adam moment state of the 12k runs was not archived, so exact continuation is impossible: moments restart from zero (disclosed restart semantics). Same budget and schedule for all arms.
stage_B.convergence_rule: WL104K rule (a) unchanged, applied to the extension: >= 90 % of (material, start) units per arm change their own training objective by <= 0.5 % relative over the extension's last 2,000 steps. PASS / FAIL per arm; optimization qualification = PASS only if all arms pass. The rule is not relaxed.
stage_B.stationarity: At the 12k and the extended states: full-batch float32 gradient of the training objective; projected gradient (for gate knots at 0 with positive gradient or at 1 with negative gradient the component is set to 0; i.e. the KKT-feasible descent direction); its norm relative to the gradient norm at the common start; counts of gate knots at 0 and at 1 (active constraints); response change between 12k and extended states on the evaluation lanes (luminance RMS / RMS).
stage_B.angular_stability: Evaluate the extended states exactly as WL104K (independent WL104D reference; contrasts T - A, P - T, P - A; cluster bootstrap seed 1041140). STABLE iff every contrast's cohort median changes by <= 3 percentage points and keeps its sign. The WL104K practical-gain criteria are re-applied descriptively to the extended states (they do not change WL104K's frozen verdict).

stage_C.lanes: Per scene, an experiment-local Dr.Jit pass with the frozen camera, geometry and light traces 16 jittered camera samples per pixel (independent stream: PCG32 initstate 1041200 + scene index) and records, for every lane whose first vertex is an ER object (sphere or cube) with a visible light: pixel, object id, local wi (view side), local wo (light side) and the light weight rgb / d^2.
stage_C.physical_response: Layered reference f cos(theta_o) at exactly those (wi, wo) pairs: data81.ref_eval (the WL104D reference evaluator, depth 1024), 8,192 walks per lane in two independent halves, seed 1041210 + scene index, sequence range starting at pair0 = 2^29 (disjoint from all previous streams).
stage_C.model_response: A / T / P at the same pairs for every start, 12k and extended states (float64 torch).
stage_C.correspondence_check: Per scene and region (objects, sphere, cube, highlight_core, highlight_ring, grazing, sphere_lower), the lane-predicted E1 region sum (mean over lanes of F x weight per pixel) must agree with the rendered fixed-pass E1 ER part (A / T / P, start-mean over replicates) within 2 % relative for the models, and with the archived layered reference E1 minus the common N part within 3 % or 3 combined standard errors. Failure stops the attribution for that scene.
stage_C.metrics: Scene-conditioned response error per region: signed excess sum(w (F_model - F_ref)) / sum(w F_ref) and L1 sum(w |F_model - F_ref|) / sum(w F_ref) (luminance, w = light weight), with walk-noise standard errors from the two halves; distribution of the contributing directions (view polar, light polar, mirror-offset angle) weighted by w F_ref; scene-conditioned error binned by mirror-offset angle and by view polar; comparison of the contributing directions with the angular-evaluation probe coverage.
stage_C.attribution_rule_hard_1_highlight: In the hard_1 highlight core: ANGULAR_RESPONSE_OVERSHOOT if P's lane-level signed excess over the physical reference is > 0 with lower 95 % bound > 0 (walk noise) for >= 3 of 4 starts AND P's lane-level excess minus A's explains >= 80 % of the rendered (P - A) E1 signed difference in that region; START_DEPENDENT if the sign of P's excess differs across starts (< 3 of 4); NOISE_COMPATIBLE if the interval includes 0 for >= 2 starts; otherwise MIXED. The same quantities are reported for the shoulder (highlight_ring) and grazing regions and for all scenes.
stage_C.no_refit: Scene-conditioned measurements are never used to fit, select or tune any state.

stage_D.holdout: No independent material / lighting scene exists under the existing qualified scene contracts: the WL104G-archived fixed-proposal inputs exist only for the three post hoc scenes, and the remaining WL104D scene (iid_0_L2) failed the WL104D scene precision gate. No replacement scene is constructed.
stage_D.new_streams: The stage C lane evaluation uses new independent camera and walk streams (stage C). The scene fixed-proposal replay of the EXTENDED states reuses the archived seeds (paired with the 12k replay; common random numbers), and is development evidence.

scene_utility_rule: Per scene and state set (12k, extended): per start, fixed TOTAL objects stable RMS relative change (P - A) / A with 12-replicate jackknife. STABLE_IMPROVEMENT if all 4 starts have upper bound < 0; STABLE_REGRESSION if all 4 starts have lower bound > 0; MIXED otherwise. Also reported for E1 and E2.
integration_question: Further integration work is JUSTIFIED by this evidence iff optimization qualification PASS, angular STABLE, and scene utility (extended states) STABLE_IMPROVEMENT in >= 2 of 3 scenes with no STABLE_REGRESSION in TOTAL or E1; NOT_JUSTIFIED if any scene shows STABLE_REGRESSION in TOTAL with the extended states; UNRESOLVED otherwise. Candidate adoption readiness is reported factually (sampler / pdf for the gated response not designed; experiment-local evaluator only).
pre_freeze_development: The protocol text above was written before any code ran. Development runs on scratch copies, before this freeze: stage A (reproduction exact, 0.0 relative), a lane-attribution smoke on hard_1, and one end-to-end dev chain with a 2,100-step extension (WL104KA_DEV_STEPS; evidence uses 12,000). Because stage C on the frozen 12k states is deterministic, the 12k stage-C numbers and labels of all three scenes were seen during development (hard_1 highlight core: MIXED; lane correspondence within 0.3 % for the models). The 2,100-step extension results are not evidence. No rule, threshold, region, bin or seed was changed after any development output; the only change after the dev chain was none to rules (figure code only).
stops: lane correspondence failure (stage C, per scene)
response-contract violation (reciprocity / passivity of extended states, tests104k --fitted)
